· 52주 위치(33.6%) + 현 가격대 52주 저점($94,500) 대비 높은 수준이나 고점 대비 큰 폭 하락.
[모멘텀 지표]

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($167,300): 20일 저가 대비 하회 가능성.
· 스윙 저항선 ($209,000): 단기 반등 시 저항 구간.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Lower Low 지속): 약세 추세 확인.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (5일 평균 대비 1.88배): 급증 거래량 동반 하락, 매도세 강함.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적 구간): RSI 과매도 진입 및 ADX 추세 약화 지속으로 추가 하락 가능성 염두, 관망 유지 조건.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($188,700) vs SMA5/20/50($211,340/$220,685/$244,660): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, indicating a bearish trend position.
· Significant decline below SMA100/200($260,454/$235,363): Weakening of long-term trend.
· 52-week position (33.6%) + Current price level is high relative to 52-week low($94,500) but significantly down from the high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.4 → 32.0): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (966.6602 → -1972.2513): Continued worsening, bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (near lower band $193,922): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($167,300): Potential to fall below 20-day low.
· Swing resistance level ($209,000): Resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low continues): Confirmation of bearish trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.88x vs 5-day average): Decline accompanied by surge in volume, indicating strong selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Considering potential for further decline due to RSI entering oversold and ADX trend weakening, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
